notes.title: Major Patch Update - End of Community Test Branch
notes.content:
After two weeks of testing and positive feedback from the loyal Winter Ember community, the Community Beta Branch is getting pushed LIVE on the Main branch! As a result of this change, we will be disabling the Community Beta Branch.

Please head to this announcement to see the patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1417880/view/5974602444930109243]here. [/url]

We would like to express our deepest gratitude to those that stuck by us and gave us crucial feedback during the updating process. We hope you continue to voice your concerns and without any more fluff… ENJOY!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.5.7
notes.content:
[b]This patch is an experimental build intended for the Community Beta Branch. It may be unstable or contain many new bugs. If you would like to learn more about our experimental process or how to opt in to our Community Beta Branch to access the experimental build, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1417880/view/5974602444930097631]please see this post.[/url][/b]

Hello everyone,

We have spent a lot of time collecting feedback from you since Winter Ember’s launch. Much of the past several weeks was spent rebalancing and addressing the many concerns raised by the community. We hope that in this new experimental build, you will find many of those concerns dealt with.

With that said, here are the patch notes! Brace yourselves, it’s going to be a long one :)

[h2]Saving[/h2]
[list][*]Quick save and quick load implemented[/list]
[h2]Combat[/h2]
[list]
[*]Parry button moved from middle mouse button to V key
[*]Enemies now have health bars
[*]Reduced enemy attack output
[*]Fixed enemies hitting Arthur as they die
[*]Fixed player being able to hit guards on crates
[*]Reduced enemy arrow block chance
[*]Increased Arthur’s attack output
[*]Increased Arthur’s arrow draw speed
[*]Decreased dog attack output and aggressiveness
[*]Enemies can now get stealth-attacked while being smoked
[*]Increased Guard collars’ brightness to improve visibility
[*]Player can now aim directly after sprinting (and vice versa)
[*]Fixed a bug where player was able to pull sword out whilst crouched
[*]Removed circle block and added a block bar to player and NPCs
[*]Modified enemy block amount for rebalancing
[*]Poison now prevents enemy from blocking
[*]Reduced heavy attack charge time from 1.25 to 1.00 seconds
[*]Dynamic skill icons now display on screen when using certain skills
[*]Changed Full Moon Specter skill attributes - whenever player dies, skill will always activate allowing [*]Arthur a second chance. Skill is on a cooldown
[*]Stealth attack now more responsive[/list]
[h2]Cover[/h2]
[list]
[*]Removed minimum cover range
[*]Snap to cover implemented
[*]Exit cover now based on directional input
[*]Movement is now directional depending on the camera’s angle
[*]Stealth attack from cover improved[/list]
[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Experimental Smooth Frame Rate disabled - PC is no longer capped at 60fps
[*]FOG optimization
[*]Window and window flap mesh optimization
[*]Breathing FX particle now only spawns on nearby characters to improve performance
[*]Improved the general game performance[/list]
[h2]Collision Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Sewers area collision improved
[*]Rope Anchor mesh collision improved
[*]Disabled collision for the following: Lamp, Candle, Broom, Bucket, Pot
[*]Fixed Pipe not having static collision (for cover)
[*]Tweaked Warehouse train track pawn collision
[*]Fixed many collisions causing player to get stuck in Midgown and Oldworld Stone
[*]Nala the cat no longer collides with the player[/list]
[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*]Completely new Japanese localization[/list]
[h2]General Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Pulled camera distance back
[*]Improved jump mechanics
[*]Fixed warehouse issue where cart dropping barrels overlapped player, glitching movement
[*]Candle Wall Light no longer blocks characters
[*]Train level now has physics-enabled stools
[*]Cover icon no longer shows when carrying bodies
[*]Fixed glitching player cloak physics when manhole and carriage teleporting
[*]Fixed ladder icon appearing when player is actually too far away
[*]Implemented a ‘recently crafted arrows’ list
[*]Fixed torch light shadow
[*]Modified Warehouse level, opening more ways to travel to rooftop
[*]Increased volume on broken glass to make it more obvious
[*]Evening purge area has additional hiding spots and minor level changes
[*]Altered Midgown to include a secondary way for the player to enter Battista’s compound
[*]Added another electricity blueprint to Midgown
[*]Changes to Greater Heaven HQ which were missed on release
[*]Fixed interactable books with physics flying upon reloading
[*]Fixed player pulling sword while in vent[/list]

notes.title: Community Beta Branch Info
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

So, you’re interested in helping improve to the Winter Ember experience, and want to try the experimental build? Read ahead! Here, you will find information about how to opt into the Community Beta Branch and what you can expect.

[quote=author][b]First and foremost, a warning about using the Community Beta Branch! We have massively refactored the save system, now including the ability to quick save! By agreeing to play on the beta version of Winter Ember, you acknowledge you may not be able to return to the original version of Winter Ember and will have to wait until we merge the beta version to the main branch.
To avoid this, we HIGHLY RECOMMEND you backup your current save by creating a copy of it and storing it in a different location before testing on the Community Beta Branch. 

The path of your save file should be:
…Users\[YourName]\AppData\Local\WinterEmber\Saved\SaveGames[/b]

[b]Note: AppData will be a hidden folder.[/b][/quote]
[h2]What is the Community Beta Branch?[/h2]
The Community Beta Branch is a beta test branch for Winter Ember, where we will push updated builds for community feedback before it is ready for the main branch. If you would like to help us shape the Winter Ember experience, you will be able to play the newest updated features, new systems, and bug fixes in the builds that get pushed to this branch.

[h2]How can I play on the Community Beta Branch?[/h2]
Opting into the Community Beta Branch is simple and easy. Right click Winter Ember in your Steam Library and go to Properties. Click into the BETAS section and select the Community Beta Branch from the drop-down menu. You should then see Steam update your game. 

[h2]What if I no longer want to play on the Community Beta Branch?[/h2]
Opting out of the Community Beta Branch is the same process as opting in, except instead of selecting the Community Beta Branch from the drop-down menu, simply select ‘None’. You should see Steam update your game build back to the main branch. Make sure you swap in your backed-up save files from before you opted into the Community Beta Branch, to ensure smooth gameplay when returning to the main version of Winter Ember. Naturally, you will lose all progress made in the beta version. Using save files from the beta version of Winter Ember on the main version of Winter Ember is [b]COMPLETELY UNTESTED. [/b]

The same logic of backing up your beta save files holds true if you plan to opt back into the beta version later, or wish to continue from the progress you have made in the beta version when we finally release the new version to the main branch.

[h2]How often will you be updating the Community Beta Branch?[/h2]
We currently don’t have a specific schedule or cadence for experimental updates. We are continuing to read and address community feedback as well as feedback from our internal QA teams. As we are currently reworking many things that are larger than simple ‘bug fixes’ and contain changes to design-related features, we will first and foremost be pushing these new builds to this Community Beta Branch.

[h2]Where can I find patch notes for the experimental builds?[/h2]
Patch notes will continually be posted on Steam as normal. We will be sure to make it clear if any patch notes are referring to changes in the Community Beta Branch.

[h2]How do I report issues or give feedback?[/h2]
You may continue to report issues as normal either through discussion on Steam or by sending us an email at support@blowfishstudios.com

Thank you very much for supporting us as we continue to improve and update Winter Ember! Please send us your feedback about the new changes in the Community Beta Branch, even if it is just to let us know that it improves the Winter Ember experience positively! Your feedback is very much appreciated!

notes.title: Winter Ember Dev Update - 10th June 2021
notes.content:
[h3][b]Assassins, thieves and rebels rejoice![/b][/h3]

We have plenty to update you on regarding our upcoming stealth adventure title Winter Ember. The developers have been hard at work updating critical elements of the game based on community feedback. We can finally give you a sneak peek at what some of these additions bring to Arthur Artorias’ vast array of tools and trinkets.

[h3][b]Controls Tweaks & Updates[/b][/h3]

[list][*] [b]Full 360 degree camera rotation, New directional movement - Arthur can now stand and run![/b] Gain an upper hand in Arthur’s quest for vengeance as players are now able to freely rotate the camera in full and enjoy full directional movement. Now it is even easier to plot your next move as you navigate the cold perils of Anargal. And as much as Arthur loves to squat and crouch, there is no better way to escape capture from guards than to run!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805269/23bf82131c283087656e576a560f2e7ecba95dcd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805269/cf46152391d075bf610d1dbe59b7bf3ed4be546f.gif[/img][/list]
[list][*] [b]Seamless transition into combat, plus combat speed increased - Arthur can now roll![/b] Arthur can now transition into battle as soon as he is spotted by guards. Not only can players get into battle quicker now - Arthur has more speed behind him too! Manage each sword fight more effectively with Arthur’s speed boost, and his newfound dodge ability!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805269/13a2f90bf3a63bbe98586ca605d3c5462a4b56d0.gif[/img][/list]
[h3][b]General Gameplay Updates[/b][/h3]

[list][*] [b]More aggressive, agile AI behavior - leading to AI that block & dodge more often. The Greater Heaven can now use rifles![/b] The team at Sky Machine Studios have reworked the AI System to give players a more varied and intense experience while confronting the legion of enemies awaiting Arthur in Anargal. But don’t feel too comfortable with creating distance from guards, however - the Greater Heaven can now shoot on sight with their shiny new rifles! Thankfully, they'll need to reload after each shot - so make the most of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805269/eae521345ec1f97100e9d8a984fa71fb3577ae96.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805269/86ed076c9c19a8e468e25859e19bdcfe2d22e199.gif[/img][/list]
[list][*] [b]Dogs can easily sniff Arthur out, and Civilians will react to Arthur - and alert nearby guards![/b] Boxes are no longer a source of reprieve when sneaking the ground when guard dogs are on your trail. Despite what the old saying says, dogs are not Arthur’s best friend. And be careful where you brandish your sword - the citizens of Anargal will flee from any sign of hostility, making it that much harder to sneak through undetected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38805269/c4a8fd6dd45d93728b79de571a541c94a3f400ef.gif[/img][/list]
This is merely a taste of what we have in store for you as we get closer to launch. We will have more to say in regards to a release date soon, so be sure to wishlist Winter Ember to stay up to date with the game’s progress.

[i][b]Until then, keep your blades sharp and your wits sharper still![/b][/i]
